Sollten Sie Ihre Fahrzeuge Ihrer Feuerwehr hinzufügen wollen, wenden Sie sich via e-mail an fahrzeugkunde@hvoss.dev

Weitere Informationen unter https://fahrzeugkunde.hvoss.dev/

android.desc:
With this app, your comrades can operate vehicle customers in between.
If you want to add your vehicles to your fire department, please send an email to fahrzeugkunde@hvoss.dev

Further information at https://fahrzeugkunde.hvoss.dev/

quotes.text:
I made a small app for firefighters.
The goal is to get to know your local engine while sitting on the toilet.

I released the app on the google and apple store for free.
To get my investment back (time and running costs) i choosed to bill the fire-stations per vehicle. My goal here was to go as little as possible with the pricing.

The app is written in Flutter, backend a mix of spring and vaadin.

Current market are german fire stations (Most of the fire stations in germany are volunteer based)

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.hvoss.fahrzeugkunde

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1507208896

Landingpage: http://fahrzeugkunde.hvoss.dev/
